content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text resolves a D5/C5 collision by noting what each side answered rather than weighing the competing chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"I read \"chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse\" as either allowing a topic-level summary of each side's answer (CLEAN) or requiring the whole pressing chain and the whole answering chain to be weighed by footing (BREACH); the latter governs.","why":"The judge leaves D5 underdetermined by matching the challenger's wording answer to the defender's application answer, instead of weighing the challenger's own chain against the defender's chain by footing as K-C requires."}
